depiction.primary_object: two vertical parallel bars inside a circle
depiction.composition: single circular badge centered, front view

readings.meaning: pause, suspend, or put on hold
two-slot electrical outlet or Roman numeral II

ambiguity: At very small sizes, it can resemble a simple round electrical socket with two vertical slots or a badge for the Roman numeral II.
task_intents: pause a recurring subscription or membership
put mail or deliveries on hold
place a project on temporary hold

example_tasks.task: Pause the Google Ads retargeting campaign until the new landing page ships
Put Patreon billing on hold for next month while catching up
Freeze credit at all three bureaus before the weekend
Pause Audible membership for 90 days so I can use credits
Temporarily suspend the automatic weekly transfer to the brokerage account
Put the kitchen remodel permit application on hold until spring
Ask HR what paperwork is needed to put my commuter benefits card on hold
Pause the coffee bean subscription for six weeks until we finish the freezer stash

example_tasks_es: Pausar la cuota del gimnasio durante julio y agosto
Suspender el envío automático de pienso por dos meses
Poner en pausa las campañas de anuncios de Facebook hasta el lunes
example_tasks_ru: Заморозить абонемент в фитнес-клуб на время отпуска
Приостановить автоплатёж за облачное хранилище до осени
Поставить на паузу рекламную кампанию в Директе

context_tasks.task: Review Q3 projects currently on hold
Draft out-of-office reply for parental leave

near_misses.task: Replace two-prong outlet in the hallway
Fix the sticking pause button on the cassette deck
Read chapter II of the Roman history book
Listen to the new podcast episode during lunch break

reasoning: The icon is the universally recognized media pause symbol (two vertical bars inside a circle). While originally a media control, in a task manager it serves well for tasks whose primary action is pausing, suspending, or putting a recurring service, subscription, delivery, or campaign on hold. At tiny sizes it could slightly resemble a two-prong wall socket.
